description.value: Freshslice Pizza is a BC-founded pizza chain offering by-the-slice and whole-pie options for pickup or delivery. This location sits on the UBC campus at University Boulevard, making it a convenient calorie stop for cyclists on the loop routes through Pacific Spirit Regional Park or the UBC endowment lands. The chain is known for any-topping slices available throughout the day.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (20 spaces, covered) at 25m; stands (10 spaces, covered) at 40m. Total: 30 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM confirms an active Freshslice Pizza fast-food location at UBC (University Boulevard, V6T 1Z1) with takeaway=yes. The fetched website is the corporate Freshslice site, which confirms the brand is live and offers in-store pickup and delivery, but the /our-locations/ page is a dynamic map requiring user input and returned no location-specific data. No cyclist amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned on either OSM or the website.
concerns: Website is corporate/chain-level only; the /our-locations/ dynamic map did not return specific data for this UBC unit (LL303), so phone number and address could not be cross-confirmed.
OSM addr:unit LL303 suggests the unit is at a lower-level (LL = lower level) of a building — cyclists should be aware this may not be at street level.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast-food chain location on the UBC campus. A useful refueling stop for touring cyclists in the area.
